card.title: Decompose
card.subtitle: break the passage into moves
card.status_plain: The moves for this passage exist (55 of them). They were read from a retyped copy, not yet the library checkout — so this is a worked example, honest about that.
card.status_tag: BUILT (55 moves) · from retyped copy — re-run fresh from checkout to finalize

layer_1_what_it_is.what_it_is: Break the passage into 'moves' — the small actions the text makes. A move is one thing done: an agent does an operation to something, with a result (e.g. 'the women flee the tomb', 'they say nothing to anyone').
layer_1_what_it_is.why_it_matters: The move is the unit we actually analyze. It's small enough to see exactly what the text does, and everything later — the gaps, the glosses — hangs off moves. Break it well and the rest follows; break it badly and everything downstream inherits the mistake.

the_process.you ask for: the checked-out passage (the output of the Text step)
the_process.the method does: reads it sentence by sentence · marks each small action as a move · labels who does it, the operation, what it acts on, and the result · notes how moves connect (one feeds the next, or one reports another's speech)
the_process.you get back: an ordered list of moves — the passage as a sequence of small, labelled actions

featured_moves.plain: Once the rest-day had ended, the three named women purchased aromatic spices intending to go and dress the body.

grammar.who: Mary Magdalene, Mary mother of James, and Salome
grammar.result: spices in hand, with the intent to come and anoint him

featured_moves.plain: He announces that the one they seek has been raised.

grammar.to: Jesus (as the one whose state is proclaimed)
grammar.result: the raising declared as accomplished; doer of the raising unnamed

featured_moves.plain: The women rushed out of the tomb in flight.

grammar.result: the women away from the tomb

featured_moves.plain: They kept silent, telling no one anything.

grammar.to: the message they had just been given (M10a-c)
grammar.result: the commission un-executed; the news withheld

layer_2_on_mark_16.the_silence_thread: M22 (the women flee) → M23 (they say nothing) — the ending the whole reading turns on. Watch this move-pair through the later steps.
layer_2_on_mark_16.all_moves_note: The full list of 55 moves is the feed the reading room already renders (reading.html renders 'live from the coded-move export').
